name: x-blocker
description: Firefox and Chrome extension to mass-block accounts on X (Twitter)

scripts.lint: node scripts/build.mjs firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.start:chrome: node scripts/build.mjs chrome && web-ext run --source-dir dist/chrome --target chromium --start-url https://x.com/home
scripts.package: node scripts/build.mjs && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist --filename x-blocker-firefox-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir dist --filename x-blocker-chrome-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
